title: Schedule of Liquidated Damages — Commercial Natural Gas Supply
content:
This schedule sets, for each Commercial Natural Gas Supply plan, the early termination fee terms: whether a fee applies, the liquidated damages rate per remaining contract therm, the minimum fee, how remaining therms are estimated, the free window before contract end and whether closing the site waives the fee.

| Plan | Fee method | Rate per remaining contract therm (USD) | Minimum fee (USD) | Free window before contract end (calendar days) | Fee waived when the business closes the site |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Beacon Ridge Commercial Gas Monthly Index | None | 0.0000 | 0.00 | 0 | No |
| Beacon Ridge Commercial Gas Fixed Basis 12 | Per remaining therm | 0.0500 | 150.00 | 30 | No |
| Beacon Ridge Commercial Gas Fixed 12 | Per remaining therm | 0.0750 | 200.00 | 30 | No |
| Beacon Ridge Commercial Gas Fixed 24 | Per remaining therm | 0.0900 | 300.00 | 30 | No |
| Beacon Ridge Commercial Gas Fixed 36 | Per remaining therm | 0.1000 | 400.00 | 45 | No |
| Beacon Ridge Commercial Gas Carbon Neutral 24 | Per remaining therm | 0.0900 | 300.00 | 30 | No |

**Remaining volume basis (all plans):** remaining contract therms are estimated as the contracted annual therms prorated by the remaining months of the term.

## Notes

- The Beacon Ridge Commercial Gas Monthly Index plan carries no early termination fee; its rate, minimum and free window are shown as zero.
- The Fixed 36 plan has the highest rate ($0.1000 per therm), the highest minimum ($400.00) and the longest free window (45 calendar days).
- The Fixed 24 and Carbon Neutral 24 plans share the same terms: $0.0900 per therm, a $300.00 minimum and a 30-day free window.
- On no plan does closing the site waive the fee.
